name: album-studio
description: Album Studio by Creative Hubb: plan, render, edit and deliver photo albums on the Mac. A native app: the PhotoCraft editor and engine, a web interface, and a Node.js helper. No Photoshop.

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.js && npm --prefix native/backend test && npm --prefix native/ui test
scripts.lint: npm run lint:eslint && npm run check:readability
scripts.lint:eslint: eslint --max-warnings 0 eslint.config.mjs src test server scripts bench native
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p native/backend && npm --prefix native/ui run typecheck
